Here are 5 great places to see in Jaipur, numbered in a sensible order for one day out. Start at Amber Fort early, before the crowds and the heat.

Amber Fort
Hilltop fort with mirror-work halls and great views.
2
Jal Mahal
Palace in the middle of Man Sagar Lake, best for a quick photo stop.
3
Hawa Mahal
The pink honeycomb facade, loveliest in morning light.
4
City Palace
Royal museum and courtyards, right next to Jantar Mantar.
5
Nahargarh Fort
Good for sunset over the Pink City.
